name: ScamProtection-Ai
description: ScamProtAI is an AI-powered cybersecurity project that detects potential scam and phishing messages and suspicious URLs. It uses Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to analyze user-provided content, classify it as Safe, Suspicious, or Likely Scam, and provide understandable reasons and safety recommendations.

paragraphs: ScamProtAI is an AI-powered cybersecurity web application designed to help users identify potential scam and phishing messages and suspicious online content.
The system analyzes user-provided content and provides an easy-to-understand risk classification to improve cybersecurity awareness and help users make safer decisions online.
features: Analyze suspicious messages and identify potential scam or phishing patterns.
Analyze URLs for suspicious characteristics and potential phishing indicators.
Generate a risk score to help users understand the severity of the detected threat.
Instead of only displaying a prediction, ScamProtAI explains the suspicious indicators detected in the input.
Provides practical recommendations to help users avoid scams.

whatItDoes.text: ScamProtAI is an AI-powered cybersecurity web application designed to help users identify potential scam and phishing messages and suspicious online content.
